purpose: Offline identity and gate pins for a valid Metal-vs-CUDA embed placement measurement. Ready means only authorized spend remains. This file does not authorize spend, advertise a cell, or promote anything.

historical_lane_evidence.note: The power-analysis receipt is the hetero-runtime lane's historical DESIGN_AND_PRIOR_MEASUREMENT (spent_usd_this_receipt=0, UNBOUND). Figures are derived from the cited prior A40 receipts, not re-measured on this consume (90ff8869 / 9c5a9f25). No GPU spend. Do not treat as a current-HEAD measurement.

vllm_cuda.note: Third engine arm on the embed contract. Metal is dual-wire (safetensors for candle, F16 GGUF for llama.cpp). CUDA/vLLM is a third arm that loads the HF safetensors artifact (same bytes as candle) through a different engine path — not a fourth file format, but a third wire path whose digest is pinned the same way.

cuda_image_pin.note: Immutable OCI digest only. Mutable tags are why evidence/runpod/spend-rr7b6uwmivaolh.json is WITHDRAWN and citable by nothing. scripts/runpod-vllm.sh refuses any image without @sha256:.

money_bounds.lifetime_source: scripts/runpod-spend-guard.py:LIFETIME_SHARE_OF_CAP and budget_seconds(); scripts/runpod-vllm.sh experiment enforces BUDGET_SECS

startup.description: vLLM readiness poll: 90 attempts x 6s sleep, curl --max-time 10 per attempt; failure tears down via exit trap

idle_or_lifetime.description: Governed experiment lifetime bound is budget_seconds(cost_per_hr, cap_usd); experiment command is killed when elapsed >= BUDGET_SECS. Non-experiment hold is MERC_RUNPOD_HOLD_SECS (default 60).

teardown_and_orphan.teardown_path: scripts/runpod-vllm.sh (terminate + trap sweep_all on experiment EXIT/INT/TERM; teardown_verified requires pod_exists=no)

spend_receipt_writer.producer_identity_requirement: BOUND producer_identity via the eight-field programme bar (scripts/lib/evidence_binding.py emit_bound_json → write_bound_evidence)
spend_receipt_writer.note: Fresh receipts written with --out bind producer_identity and lift the immutable image @sha256 into image_digest. Historical spend-rr7b6uwmivaolh.json remains WITHDRAWN for mutable tag and is not restamped.

selector_consumer.note: Shadow/governed comparison structure exists and records CUDA embed exclusion until a matched paid arm is eligible. It does not promote.

cross_hardware_cost_authority.note: Cost may never be compared across hardware classes; the difference would be the machine, not the placement. Heterogeneous placement must not invent a cross-hardware USD authority.

parity_with_metal.note: Comparable CUDA embed arm at parity with candle-metal-minilm-embed. Remains DRAFT until promotion clears both promotionMatchedPairAuthorityRefusal and the scope/global-lifecycle refusal. Never by editing lifecycle.

must_remain: DRAFT lifecycle under DRAFT vllm_cuda profile
cell_surface_policy.reason: Identity for a future matched placement measurement. Not a capability offered to buyers.

generation_quality_refusal.note: Metal catalogue generation is GGUF q4; CUDA vLLM profile is HF bf16. Not multi-family substitutable under byte_exact. Do not rank them on price.

A global-coverage promotion model (or scoped lifecycle) so narrow-scope evidence can authorize the lifecycle change the activation table currently treats as global
